question: An article is sold at a profit of 13.25%. Had it been sold for Rs.76.70 more, the profit would have been 16.2%. 20% of the cost price of the article (in Rs.) is:
solution:
**Formula:**

SP = CP + P, where

SP = Selling price

CP = Cost Price

P = Profit

Calculations:

Let the cost price be Rs 100.

SP for 13.25% profit = Rs 100 + 13.25 = Rs 113.25

SP for 16.2% profit = Rs 100 + 16.20&nbs
